metadata.description: Rosetta 3 - Software Engineering Accelerator providing AI agents with unified access to instructions, workflows, skills, and business context

plugins.name: rosetta
plugins.description: Rosetta for Copilot - Software Engineering Accelerator instruction set, workflows, and guardrails. Includes Rosetta MCP for knowledge base access.

plugins.name: rosetta-light
plugins.description: Rosetta for Copilot - Software Engineering Accelerator instruction set, workflows, and guardrails. Includes Rosetta MCP for knowledge base access. (lightweight profile: simpler workflows, smaller models)

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Rosetta for Copilot - core set: composable skills, always-on rules, bootstrap and guardrail hooks; required by every other Rosetta plugin.

plugins.name: advanced
plugins.description: Rosetta for Copilot - advanced set: subagents, workflows, and orchestration automation. Requires the `core` plugin.

plugins.name: qe
plugins.description: Rosetta for Copilot - qe set: test automation and test generation. Requires the `core` and `advanced` plugins.

plugins.name: search
plugins.description: Rosetta for Copilot - search set: Solr and search engineering. Requires the `core` and `advanced` plugins.

plugins.name: modernization
plugins.description: Rosetta for Copilot - modernization set: conversion, modernization, and re-architecture. Requires the `core` and `advanced` plugins.
